sets.title: Recognize
sets.description: Identify verbal adverb types and the same-subject rule, then pick between close pairs
sets.descriptionRussian: Определите типы деепричастий и правило одного субъекта, затем выберите из близких пар

items.prompt: Which verbal adverb expresses a SIMULTANEOUS action?
items.explanation: Читая (imperfective, -я) expresses an action happening at the same time as the main verb.

items.prompt: _____ письмо, она пошла на почту. (having written)
items.promptEnglish: Having written the letter, she went to the post office.
items.explanation: Perfective verbal adverb: написать -> написав. The writing finished before the trip to the post office.

items.prompt: Why is this sentence WRONG? "Читая книгу, зазвонил телефон."
items.explanation: Подлежащее деепричастия должно совпадать с подлежащим главного предложения. Здесь «читая» подразумевает человека, но подлежащее - «телефон», а телефон читать не может.

items.prompt: Which sentence correctly uses the same-subject rule?
items.hint: The same person must do both actions.
items.explanation: Only 'Вернувшись домой, он приготовил ужин' has the same subject: he returned, he cooked. In the others, rain/cat/cup are different subjects.

items.prompt: Which is an idiomatic verbal adverb phrase?
items.promptEnglish: Which functions as a set expression?
items.hint: Some verbal adverb phrases have become fixed expressions.
items.explanation: Грубо говоря (roughly speaking) is an idiomatic set phrase. Others: мягко выражаясь, судя по, начиная с.

minimalPairs.context: _____ задачу, она перешла к следующей. (completed it first)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Having solved the problem, she moved on to the next one.
minimalPairs.explanation: Preceding: perfective решив. She finished solving, then moved to the next one.

minimalPairs.contextEnglish: While solving the problem, she chewed on a pencil.
minimalPairs.explanation: Simultaneous: imperfective решая. Both actions happened at the same time.

minimalPairs.context: _____ в комнату, Лена увидела кота на столе. (entered, then saw)
minimalPairs.contextEnglish: Having entered the room, Lena saw a cat on the table.
minimalPairs.explanation: Preceding: perfective войдя. She entered first, then noticed the cat.

translation.english: While reading a letter, she smiled.
translation.grammarFocus: Imperfective verbal adverb for simultaneous action

translation.english: Having finished the project, the team celebrated.
translation.hint: Preceding completed action = perfective verbal adverb
translation.grammarFocus: Perfective verbal adverb for preceding action

translation.english: Not understanding the question, the student asked again.
translation.hint: Not + verbal adverb. Could be perfective (failed to understand) or imperfective (was not understanding).

translation.english: Roughly speaking, the plan is good.
translation.hint: Idiomatic verbal adverb phrase: грубо говоря
